messages:
matt: Heads up — p99 tail for prefill is up ~3% after the kernel-mapper tweak. Looks concentrated on decode-heavy traces. Anyone else seeing this?

anya: Yeah, spotted the same on staging. p95 is fine, but p99 shifts for 512+ token runs.

rui: ran a quick flame/profile. Seems like batch-formation delays during the handshake are the culprit. KV miss rate bumped from ~12% -> ~18% on the failing traces.

rui: perf snippet I ran:```
$ tools/perf/trace_collect --run=512_mix
batch_wait_ms: 3.2
handshake_wait_ms: 4.8
kv_miss_rate: 0.18
kernel_switches: 42
```

infra-bot: perf dashboard updated: https://dashboard.redwood.ai/perf/62789 — spike aligned with deploy at 11:12.

sam: Thinking out loud: split the batch-formation windows for prefill vs decode. Make decode aggressive (1ms window, target tokens ~16) and prefill lazier (6ms, target ~48). Phase-aware handshake: allow decode to steal up to 30% of prefill slots when kv_miss < 5%. Might reduce decode latency while keeping prefill throughput.

kevin: KV thrash worry is valid — if we split too aggressively prefill could see worse miss churn. Add a small priming window (first 100 tokens) where we bias batches to warm KV, or do N=3 warmup batches per session.

matt: can we do a quick A/B? rui, can you run a mixed workload driver (seed/gen 30/70) and compare baseline vs split-windows?

rui: on it. command I'll run:```
python tools/bench/mix_runner.py --seed_ratio 0.3 --tokens 512 --runs 500 --mode=baseline
python tools/bench/mix_runner.py --seed_ratio 0.3 --tokens 512 --runs 500 --mode=split_windows
```

(20m later)

rui: microbench results: baseline p99=128ms, p95=68ms, p50=12ms. split-windows p99=118ms, p95=65ms, p50=11ms. KV miss down 18% -> 9%. kernel switches -6%.

anya: Nice improvement. Can we dump kernel-switch histograms and tail CPU? handshake overhead still something to watch.

deploy-bot: canary queued: sched-split-handshake-affinity v2 -> 3 nodes (canary tag: canary-2026-03-20).

sam: rollout plan: 1) run expanded bench (1k runs, multi-tenant traces), 2) canary on 3 hosts collecting p50/p95/p99 + kv_miss + kernel_switch histograms, 3) if stable 24h, promote. I'll open a PR with flags: `split_batch_windows`, `decode_token_target`, `prefill_token_target`, `kv_priming_window`.

matt: sounds good. rui, please paste raw logs when you have them. if this holds, it's a solid perf win. :thumbsup:

rui: will post full logs + flame tarball in the thread by EOD.

kevin: also add a metric for "handshake-steal-rate" so we can see how often decode borrows prefill slots. want to ensure it doesn't grow unbounded.

anya: agreed. and add an alert if kv_miss_rate increases > 5% over baseline for prefill flows.

matt: thanks team — let's keep the changes behind a config flag and gated by canary.
